name: volibear-soldog-battlefields-kennen
description: Follow-up to the Volibear list confirmation of 12 Nov: the winning list was soldog's main deck on Ritualo's battlefields (Vilemaw's Lair, Dragon Roost, Black Market), because the search keeps the base list's battlefields. This test adds soldog's list exactly as he registered it (Sigil of the Storm, Sunken Temple, The Papertree) and repeats the comparison with Ritualo's list on new deals (seed 4343), 200 games per opponent. Volibear piloted by spec_volibear_108_v0. This request: Kennen (Evansrhim, Stuttgart 1st).
